title: StarFighter 3000
overview:
StarFighter 3000 is the next generation of space combat simulation that puts you in control of the most lethal flying machine the 31st century has ever seen. With enemy fighters, heat-seeking missiles and space cruisers to deal with, not to mention enemy SAM sites and radar installation, StarFighter 3000 is the state-of-the-art.

- 60 varied missions over 4 levels
- Unique camera viewing system
- Blistering 3D graphics
- Control up to 10 wingmen at one time
- Non-linear mission structure
- Superb soundtracks
- Bonus levels, time limits, chain reactions, extra weapons & experimental fighter
